text: 德国联邦政府与各州政府已就一项25亿欧元（29亿美元）的纾困方案达成一致，其中包括自10月起实施为期三个月的燃油税减免，以及临时加油价格上限计划，以缓解驾车者和企业面临的压力。 汽油和柴油的能源税将每升削减14欧分，加上增值税部分，总减税幅度约为17欧分。 财政部将动用今年未使用的预算资金，并通过”混合融资措施”弥补剩余部分，25亿欧元成本的一半由德国各州承担。
text_en: Germany's federal government and the state governments have agreed on a 2.5 billion euro ($2.9 billion) relief package, including a three-month fuel tax cut starting in October and a temporary fuel price cap plan, to ease the pressure on drivers and businesses. The energy tax on gasoline and diesel will be cut by 14 euro cents per liter, and together with the VAT portion, the total tax reduction will be about 17 cents. The Finance Ministry will use unused budget funds this year and cover the remainder through "mixed financing measures," with half of the 2.5 billion euro cost borne by Germany's states.
